title: Newly Upgraded • Spacious • Hillsboro Village
description:
Unwind in Hillsboro Village, only steps from shops, bars, the iconic Pancake Pantry, Vanderbilt Unviersity, Belmont – and just 2 miles from downtown's honky tonks! This luxury, professionally decorated home boasts a private rooftop patio, large second-floor balcony, high-end amenities, gig-speed internet, free parking, and a fully equipped kitchen. The home has 4 BR (8 large beds) and 3.5 BA – plus, it’s pet-friendly! This is the perfect base to relax and explore all that Nashville has to offer!

The space
The four-story property includes four bedrooms, eight beds, three and one-half baths, a full size kitchen, an open-concept second floor living room/dining room/kitchen with ample seating for large groups, a rooftop terrace, a large second floor balcony, a stackable washer/dryer, a one-car garage and small shared backyard with grass.

Guest access
The entire unit, including the garage and rooftop terrace, is private to the guests who book with us. 

There are some shared spaces outside of the unit, including the fenced in backyard and additional parking spaces within the property complex.

We are happy to accommodate early check-ins and late check-outs when possible. By request, check-ins between 1pm-4pm can be added for an additional $250, check-outs from 10am-1pm can be added for an additional $250, and both can be added for a total of $350. In advance of trip dates, we can let you know if earlier check-in (8am-1pm) or late check-out (1pm - 6pm) times can be extended for prices listed.

Other things to note
This neighborhood is fantastic and truly one of the gems of Nashville. So much to see in the immediate area, very safe, and easily walkable. Also just a short 5 minute drive to lower Broadway, where all of the world's most famous Honky Tonks await you.
